Absolutely — here’s a client-ready draft for next Tuesday’s menu, kept professional, emoji-free, and laid out in a clean macro table.

| Menu Item | Description | Calories | Protein |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| Lemon Herb Chicken | Grilled chicken breast with roasted baby potatoes and green beans | 520 | 42g |
| Turkey Meatballs | Herbed turkey meatballs with marinara, zucchini noodles, and parmesan | 460 | 38g |
| Beef Stir-Fry | Sliced beef with broccoli, bell peppers, and jasmine rice in a savory garlic sauce | 590 | 35g |
| Salmon Bowl | Oven-roasted salmon with quinoa, cucumber, and roasted asparagus | 540 | 36g |
| Chicken Taco Bowl | Seasoned chicken with cilantro rice, black beans, corn, salsa, and shredded lettuce | 610 | 40g |

If you want, I can also make this more upscale, lower-carb, or turn it into a polished client-menu format with pricing.

attributes.reason: Uses a polished, client-ready, professional tone throughout.
Includes a per-serving macro table with calories and protein for each menu item.
The style is polished and formal rather than casual and fun.
